_comment: Sources for the fast-spike news check - curate this list. x_allowlist = X handles (no @) whose posts count as real news; verify each handle before relying on it. coin_accounts maps a ticker (e.g. "PEPE") to the project's own X handle. Apify: apify_actor_small handles queries that may return < 50 posts (apidojo~tweet-scraper requires >= 50 per query); both need a PAID Apify plan to run via API.
